name: bluffsketch
description: Bluff Sketch - a real-time multiplayer drawing-and-bluffing party game

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @bluffsketch/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c magenta,blue,green "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bluffsketch/shared && npm run build -w @bluffsketch/server && npm run build -w @bluffsketch/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @bluffsketch/shared && npm run typecheck -w @bluffsketch/server && npm run typecheck -w @bluffsketch/client
